table.retrieve:
SELECT	dbo.adjBufferHeader.adjbuffercode, 
			dbo.adjBufferheader.date, 
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.posted,
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.Usercode,
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.Remarks,
			dbo.users.username,
			aliasname = dbo.item.customicode,
			itemname = dbo.item.name,
			dbo.adjbufferdetail.stockinhand,
			dbo.adjbufferdetail.stockonshelf,
			avgprice=item.avgprice,
			godown=(select name from godown where godown.gcode=adjbufferheader.gcode)

FROM 	 dbo.adjbufferHeader,
		 dbo.adjbufferDetail,
		 dbo.users, 
		 dbo.item

WHERE 	dbo.adjBufferHeader.adjbuffercode = :ai_adjcode and 
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.adjbuffercode = adjBufferDetail.adjbuffercode and 
			dbo.adjBufferHeader.usercode = dbo.users.usercode and
			dbo.adjBufferDetail.icode = dbo.item.icode

ORDER BY rowid

objects.name: c_totaladjdec
objects.expression: Sum ( IF ( ( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) <= 0 , Abs( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) , 0 ) for All )

objects.name: compute_7
objects.expression: sum(IF ( ( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) > 0 , ( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) , 0 )*avgprice for all)

objects.name: compute_6
objects.expression: sum(IF ( ( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) <= 0 , Abs( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) ,  0 )*avgprice for all)

objects.name: c_adjdec
objects.expression: IF ( ( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) <= 0 , Abs( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) ,  -1 )

objects.name: c_decval
objects.expression: IF ( ( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) <= 0 , Abs( stockonshelf - stockinhand ) ,  0 )*avgprice
